about_short_description.short_description: Zumper is the largest privately owned rental platform in North America with a mission to make renting a home as easy as booking a hotel.

product.name: Zumper Rental Marketplace
product.description: An online and mobile rental marketplace for finding, comparing, contacting, and applying to residential properties across the United States and Canada.

product.name: Zumper Rental Manager
product.description: An online property management and rental marketing platform for posting properties, distributing listings, connecting with renters, and managing rental marketing activity.

product.name: Zumper Multifamily Marketing Solutions
product.description: Marketing and market-intelligence services for multifamily housing teams, combining rental advertising, market data, pricing insights, and AI-supported analysis.

product.name: Rental Listing Advertising and Syndication
product.description: A property advertising service that lets landlords and property managers publish rental listings and distribute them across Zumper and third-party search and rental channels.

product.name: Tenant Screening
product.description: A tenant-screening service that facilitates credit, identity, background, eviction, and income-related reports through third-party providers for rental applicant evaluation.

product.name: Rental Applications and Lease Services
product.description: Digital tools that facilitate electronic rental applications, renter-to-landlord information exchange, offer processes, and certain lease-related workflows.
